scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is for a fixed interior Bernoulli prevalence and homogeneous independent relevance indicators. The conditional test deliberately conditions away total-count information, so it targets ordering rather than prevalence improvement. No rare-prevalence, heterogeneous-probability, dependent-relevance, or multi-user mixture extension is claimed. Exact conditional computation may need enumeration or dynamic programming. The originality claim is limited to the AP@k-specific exact conditional calibration, Gaussian constants, and variance split; classical Bernoulli conditioning itself is not claimed as new.
title: Conditioning out prevalence gives an exact random-order test for AP@k
